category_seo.title: Restaking - EigenLayer & Liquid Restaking | BiuBiu Tools
category_seo.description: Restaking protocols for additional yield. EigenLayer, liquid restaking tokens, and AVS (Actively Validated Services).

faqs.question: What is restaking?
faqs.answer: Restaking lets you use staked ETH to secure additional protocols (AVS) for extra yield. EigenLayer pioneered this, allowing ETH stakers to earn rewards from multiple services.

faqs.question: What are liquid restaking tokens (LRTs)?
faqs.answer: LRTs like eETH (ether.fi) or ezETH (Renzo) represent restaked ETH that you can use in DeFi. They're liquid versions of restaked positions.

faqs.question: What are the risks of restaking?
faqs.answer: Restaking adds slashing risk from AVS failures, smart contract risk, and complexity. Higher yields come with higher risk. Understand what AVS you're securing.
